defs.def: acceptable and appropriate in a particular situation 合理的；恰当的；适当的
treating everyone equally and according to the rules or law （按法律、规定）平等待人的，秉公办事的，公正的

ex.s: An expository essay contains a fair and balanced analysis of an event, a situation or an idea.
ex.t: 然后，像许多人一样，昨晚我上床睡觉，期待着明天的休息日。

ex.s: Similarly, the corporate world has certainly known its fair share of disruption, yet it is only in the last couple of decades that the “Disruptor” has become a recognisable figure in the way we talk about big business.
ex.t: 同样，企业界当然也经历了相当多的颠覆，但直到过去二十几年，“颠覆者”才成为我们谈论大企业时一个可识别的角色。

ex.s: I think it’s also fair to say that we can get our hopes up when it comes to finding cures for serious diseases, such as cancer.
ex.t: 我认为也可以公正地说，当谈到为癌症等严重疾病寻找治疗方法时，我们可能会抱有过高的期望。

defs.def: quite large in number, size or amount （数量、大小）相当大的

ex.s: "It has been fairly rewarding. ", she says, "a really positive change."
ex.t: 这是相当有回报的，她说，一个真正积极的变化。

ex.s: The ground floor of the forest is not all tangled leaves and bushes, like in films, but is actually fairly clear.
ex.t: 森林的地面并不像电影里那样全是纠缠不清的树叶和灌木，而是实际上相当开阔。

defs.def: quite good 相当好的；不错的
pale in colour 浅色的；白皙的
bright and not raining 晴朗的
not too strong and blowing in the right direction 风
honestly and according to the rules 诚实；光明正大
in a direct way that is easy to understand 直截了当

ex.s: It is fair to say, though, that our psychological biases play a major role.
ex.t: 不过，公平地说，我们的心理偏见起着主要作用。

ex.s: I decided it was not fair that I had to contribute my money.
ex.t: 我认为要我出钱是不公平的。

defs.def: exactly in the place you were aiming for 不偏不斜

ex.s: B: I see what you mean, but the audience wants fair play.
ex.t: B：我明白你的意思，但观众想要公平竞争。

defs.def: a type of entertainment in a field or park at which people can ride on large machines and play games to win prizes 露天游乐场

ex.s: The lantern fair attracts a lot of people, so it’s one of the busiest times of year for the traffic police.
ex.t: 灯会吸引了大量人流，因此这是一年中交警最忙碌的时期之一。

defs.def: a type of entertainment in a field or park at which farm animals and products are shown and take part in competitions （评比农畜产品的）集市

ex.s: Museums are working together with AI ethicists to develop fair algorithms.
ex.t: 博物馆正与人工智能伦理学家合作，开发公平的算法。

ex.s: Daji, or big open-air fairs, typically take place on specific dates of the lunar calendar, for example, on dates with five or seven as the last digit.
ex.t: 大集，即大型露天集市，通常在农历特定日子举行，例如尾数为五或七的日期。

defs.def: an event at which people, businesses, etc. show and sell their goods 商品交易会；展销会
(in the past) a market at which animals were sold （旧时）牲畜市场
an event at which people who are looking for jobs can get information about companies who might employ them 职业介绍会；就业展览会

ex.s: March 24 Thornton Middle School History Fair Competition
ex.t: 3月24日 桑顿中学历史博览会竞赛

ex.s: Understanding history is vital to understanding ourselves as a people and as a nation． History is much more than the study of dusty old objects and events long past． It is an essential part of who we are today and who we will become． Thornton Middle School History Fair Competition makes understanding history exciting， engaging， and fun!
ex.t: 理解历史对理解我们作为一个民族、一个国家的自我至关重要。历史远不止是对尘封旧物与久远事件的研究。它是我们今天之所是、未来之将是的本质部分。桑顿中学历史博览会竞赛让理解历史变得激动人心、引人入胜且充满乐趣！
